item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows two rays drawn from a common point O on Tara's slate: ray OA and ray OB.

Which statement correctly describes the angle they form?

options.A: The vertex of the angle is arm OA.
options.B: OA and OB form this angle even if they start at two different points.
options.C: The rays share starting point O (the vertex); the arms are OA and OB; the angle may be named $\angle AOB$.
options.D: The angle is named $\angle O$ because O is the first letter printed on the slate.
